messages.subject: Urgent: Important Vitals Check & Anticoagulant Reminder
messages.content: Hello Robert, our monitoring system flagged that your SpO2 has dropped to 91% and heart rate is elevated at 108 bpm, alongside a missed dose of your Eliquis. Please sit in a supported upright chair, take your morning medication immediately, and rest. If you feel shortness of breath worsening or chest discomfort, use the red Emergency Assistance button or dial 911 immediately.

messages.subject: RE: Urgent: Important Vitals Check & Anticoagulant Reminder
messages.content: Thank you Dr. Jenkins. My wife just helped me take the Eliquis. I am resting in the armchair now. My chest feels slightly tight but bearable. We will keep the pulse oximeter on.

messages.subject: Great progress on your daily check-in!
messages.content: Hi Elena, your oxygen levels are climbing nicely back to 94%. Keep doing the incentive spirometer 10 breaths every hour while awake. See you on our video visit Thursday!
